key_bullish_phrases: 2021 was one of the strongest years in PayPal's history. Our revenues grew by 18% to $25.4 billion, and our non-GAAP EPS grew 19% to $4.60.
We surpassed $1 trillion in annual TPV for the first time in our history, ending the year with $1.25 trillion of total payment volume.
Ex eBay, our revenue growth was very strong, growing 29% on a spot basis for the full year and 22% in Q4.
key_bearish_phrases: 2021 was also a difficult year. It was a particularly hard year to forecast.
eBay's migration to managed payments happened faster than we anticipated. Overall, eBay put $1.4 billion of pressure on our top line, reducing our revenue growth by 700 basis points.

2022 is going to be a year of transformation and investment as we transition from outsized growth driven by lockdowns during the pandemic and finalize the lapping of eBay's managed payments transition.
